hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.command // "" | test("auto_(update|comment)")' >/dev/null && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"auto_update y auto_comment los cambia una persona, no una sesion: ningun comando de shell los nombra"}}' || true

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "" | test("(^|/)muckpile\\.toml$")) and ([.tool_input.new_string // "", .tool_input.content // ""] | join("\n") | test("auto_(update|comment)"))' >/dev/null && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"auto_update y auto_comment de muckpile.toml los cambia una persona, no una sesion"}}' || true
